name: Beelzemon: Blast Mode
main_effect:
When this card is trashed from your deck, delete 1 of your opponent's level 3 or lower Digimon. For every 10 cards in your trash, add 1 to the maximum level of the Digimon you can choose with this effect.
[When Digivolving] Unsuspend this Digimon. If you have 20 or more cards in your trash, gain 3 memory.
